image_description: A close-up photograph showing a small, slender, dark reddish-brown snake coiled in the palm of a human hand. The snake has a smooth, glossy texture and a uniform coloration. Its head is indistinct from the body, featuring a blunt snout. The background consists of the blurred skin texture of the hand holding the reptile.

Non-testable checkpoints (ventral side, tail tip) are occluded but do not contradict the visible evidence.
